A short middle ahead, a useful reminder
The subject is staff briefings
Travelers using Aurelia Skyways with pets should review the latest check-in guidance before arrival. This notice explains how the Companion Animal Travel Desk helps keep the process orderly and calm.

Our welcome team prepares passengers for boarding and checks that travel papers, carriers, and animal needs are in good order. Staff members also answer routine questions, guide travelers to the correct service point, and help each pet move through the airport with as little stress as possible. The aim is dependable companion travel for every journey.

Please keep your pet close, follow the directions given by the desk, and arrive with all required items ready for review. If your plans change, tell the desk as soon as possible so the team can update the file and keep the departure process smooth. A brief, accurate check-in helps the whole service work well.

For help at the airport, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
